description: A space between << and the marker does not start a heredoc
notes: The spec says << is followed by an identifier and gives the grammar ("<<" | "<<-") Identifier Newline, without saying whether whitespace may separate them, while whitespace between lexical elements is generally ignored. hashicorp/hcl only recognizes a heredoc when the identifier follows immediately (BeginHeredocTmpl in hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl), so << becomes two less-than symbols.
